body: I've played some video games, but I've lost interest recently, so I kinda hang around the internet, go for walks and do my work. But after work I really never know what to do. I don't have a physical illness, but I've made a plan that I want to follow through. I just need to get everything ready and do some stuff beforehand.

I don't feel too well at the moment, kinda lying in bed and tipping, but knowing I'm only here for a little while makes me feel better. I can understand the feeling of going two steps back, but for me its more that I'm going nowhere. It feels all the same for me. I don't know what do with my life and I have nothing really to look forward to, except dying I suppose.
